scope_note: Names and definitions identify the programme and development scope. They do not establish a completed game, validated model, biological or clinical capability.
release_policy: Existing experimental previews may be published with their actual version, source and limitations. Production-grade acceptance is not a prerequisite for preview upload; privacy, redistribution rights, security and truthful scientific scope remain required. Paper content pointers distinguish selected compiled PDFs from preserved historical source snapshots; content identity does not establish remote publication verification. Git history and original local evidence remain.
license_note: Project-owned contributions CC0-1.0; third-party materials retain their own rights and notices.
development_status: active; work has resumed alongside NeuroSurge and Interoceptomics
programme_focus: NeuroTranslation, NeuroSurge and Interoceptomics are active together.

data_companion.meaning: Import and inspect recordings locally. Replay the R1 cohort fit, or compare the fixed and personally calibrated models on an imported R2 trial. Full R2 trials are checked against their archived sample clock and four selected input streams. Aggregate evidence is shown separately.
data_companion.hosting: Prepared static main/docs payload; actual Pages deployment/readback is verified separately

papers.scope: Four experimental working drafts, 546 pages; recorded targeted visual evidence covers 26 pages, with 520 outside visual acceptance; no whole-paper or biological acceptance.
papers.build_provenance: R2 technical PDFs retained; accessible editions have actual R3 builds. The R3 Brain2Body Simple English PDF equals its preceding R2 bytes.
papers.source_status: Preserved R9/R11 sources are historical, not matching build-source bundles for the current PDFs. R11 remains unbuilt/nonstandalone, with its G35 proposal unadopted.
papers.publication_scope: This metadata identifies selected content; actual publication and remote readback require a separate receipt.

download_bundle.scope: Four exact selected PDFs, three companions, README, content manifest and five notice files. No standalone font, source, model or private evidence files. Native extraction/PDF-link behavior across operating systems remains unverified.

latest_experimental_candidate.scope: Four newly rendered experimental drafts. The technical and accessible editions cover the scalp EEG and palm comparisons and the developmental rationale for Antechinus. Earlier formal selection remains identifiable.

portable_interface.status: Source only; no model payload, download, runtime or finished GUI claim
